description: This file implements the FO (Formatting Objects) form renderer for the OFBiz framework. It extends an HTML widget renderer to generate FO-compatible output for various form fields and structures, including rendering form boundaries, table layouts, and individual form elements such as text fields, dropdowns, and date fields.

classes.name: FoFormRenderer
classes.description: Implements FO (Formatting Objects) rendering of forms, extending HTML widget renderer to produce FO-compatible output for form layout and fields.
